0.original: Eshana's next task is not for the squeamish.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

24.original: Survey the designated location and defeat any slugs that appear.

48.original: You are truly a sssight for sore eyes, my friend.

49.original: Our ssscouts recently had the misfortune of spotting a monstrous slug near Dimwold. Their grotesque appearance and corrosive slime─it is enough to make one ssspew.

50.original: They mussst be dealt with, but I am ashamed to confess the Gatekeepers are ill-sssuited to fight them. The mere sight of them is enough to make mossst convulse. And those who manage to approach are then irreparably scarred by their acidic ssslavering.

51.original: Please, I beg of you─go to Dimwold and rid us of this blight on the land.

52.original: Is it done, then? Is the ssslug no more?

53.original: You have my humblessst thanks. If the Gatekeepers should encounter another, you can be certain we will call for you again.
